description: Jet 4 MDB: Single-table SELECT dynaset Edit/AddNew/Update/Delete/CancelUpdate, LockEdits(False/True), FindFirst/FindNext/NoMatch, Bookmark, and aliased column projection at depth 0, inside BeginTrans+CommitTrans, and inside BeginTrans+Rollback, plus non-updatable SELECT controls (DISTINCT, aggregate, computed column). Keeps all pages.

args.text: CREATE TABLE T (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_T PRIMARY KEY, N LONG, S TEXT(30))
SELECT ID, N, S AS Label FROM T WHERE ID >= 1 ORDER BY ID
SELECT ID, N, S FROM T ORDER BY ID
SELECT ID, N, S FROM T ORDER BY ID
SELECT COUNT(*) AS C FROM T
SELECT ID, N + 1 AS N1, S FROM T ORDER BY ID
SELECT ID, N, S FROM T ORDER BY ID
